name: minimalist-gallery-youth-dog
image_vibe: Sophisticated minimalist, introspective, soft natural editorial
image_purpose: Create a contemporary fashion portrait featuring an adult man and companion dog.

prompt.project_info: A highly detailed minimalist art-gallery portrait of one original adult man with a friendly dog.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult man with fair skin, sharp cheekbones, medium beard, tousled light-brown wavy hair, and a calm introspective gaze. He sits relaxed on a simple black wooden stool with legs crossed, wearing an oversized black linen button-up shirt loosely tucked into matching wide-leg black trousers, black socks, and open-toe black leather gladiator-style sandals.
prompt.composition_elements: Bright empty white-walled contemporary gallery, smooth concrete floor, friendly black-and-white border collie mix lying at his feet with tongue out, small woven rope toy nearby, and a massive square abstract painting with earthy brown tones and deep shadow gradients behind him.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural diffused daylight with gentle shadows emphasizing linen, dog fur, concrete, and paint texture; sophisticated calm fashion-editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Highly detailed photorealistic fashion photography, natural perspective, realistic fabric, skin, dog fur, rope, concrete, and painting surface, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a highly detailed minimalist art-gallery portrait of an original adult man with fair skin, sharp cheekbones, medium beard, tousled light-brown wavy hair, and a calm introspective gaze directed at the camera. Seat him relaxed on a simple black wooden stool with legs crossed in a bright empty white-walled contemporary art space. He wears an oversized black linen button-up shirt loosely tucked into matching wide-leg black trousers, black socks, and open-toe black leather gladiator-style sandals. At his feet place a friendly black-and-white border collie mix with tongue out, panting happily, beside a small woven rope toy on the smooth concrete floor. Hang a massive square abstract painting with rich earthy brown tones and deep shadow gradients behind him. Use soft natural diffused daylight, gentle shadows, sophisticated contemporary fashion-editorial photography, and realistic texture with no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, distorted dog, aggressive dog, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, deformed

assets.name: source gallery dog portrait reference
assets.usage: Use only for gallery composition, menswear silhouette, dog pose, painting scale, and lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult man, black linen outfit, stool, border collie mix, rope toy, gallery, abstract painting, and soft daylight. Identity and non-essential gallery details may vary.

changes: Clarified a clearly adult subject to remove age ambiguity.
